paragraphs.text: Nari is a human member of the Hyozan Reckoners from Kamigawa .

Nari is a muscular Reckoner with a reputation for her expertise in poisons. She wears metal gloves trailing up to her elbows, each finger pointed and needle-sharp. One swipe of her hand leaves a special kind of poison that causes venomous flowers to blossom from a person's wounds. She is part of Satoru Umezawa 's Hyozan Reckoners network and was involved in keeping tabs on Kaito Shizuki , whom she suspected of being a spy. Nari is described as having a high braid and a formidable demeanor, with a tendency to speak with a hint of menace. Her role is to enforce Satoru's will and ensure that the Reckoners' interests are protected.

In a tense standoff, Kaito , his sister Eiko Shizuki , and Tameshi encountered Nari and other Reckoners in Jukai Forest, alongside a rare tanuki kami named Himoto . The situation escalated when Nari confronted Kaito, accusing him of betrayal and questioning his loyalty. As conflict brewed, Eiko and Kaito managed to fend off their attackers while the Order of Jukai arrived, adding to the chaos. Amidst the battle, Kaito made a desperate attempt to protect the kami, grabbing it and ultimately fleeing the scene with Eiko and Tameshi, as the Order clashed with the Reckoners.
